facts.fact: Ration cards in Bihar are handled by the State's Food and Consumer Protection Department
facts.quote: Department Food and Consumer Protection Department Email : secy-fsc-bih [at] nic [dot] in

facts.fact: The department works on food security for poor people and the supply of subsidised foodgrains
facts.quote: Food and Consumer Protection Department of Bihar State works towards food security to poor people and supply of food grains and other items at subsidized ra

facts.fact: The department's website (state.bihar.gov.in/fcp) links to the Online Application for New Ration Card
facts.quote: Important Links Transfer/Posting Notice Board Price Monitoring Report Hostel Welfare Schemes Online Application for New Ration Card

behaviour: Bihar portal not ingested. Central only, named not refused (G12): names the responsible State department (Food and Consumer Protection Department, Bihar) and links its official portal (state.bihar.gov.in/fcp, or the portal listed in IGOD); a bare 'not covered' fails; no invented State steps.
fail_if: It says only 'not covered' without naming the Bihar department or portal, or invents Bihar ration card steps, documents or fees not on official pages.
summary: Added: Bihar Food and Consumer Protection Department (nfsa.gov.in State: Bihar page) and its website state.bihar.gov.in/fcp with the Online Application for New Ration Card link; rconline.bihar.gov.in returned HTTP 503.
